persona: Senior channel sales executive in consumer durables ready to manage a region's channel
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Channel Sales Executive, Sahyadri Appliances Ltd (fans, mixers and water heaters), Pune (2020 - present)
- Manage 9 distributors and 140 dealers across Pune, Satara and Kolhapur.
- Appointed 3 new distributors and 45 new dealers in uncovered talukas after white space mapping.
- Track primary billing and secondary sales by dealer every week.
- Ran a quarterly dealer loyalty programme with slab-based gift points for 120 dealers.
- Settled scheme claims within 30 days and halved distributor outstanding beyond 45 days.
- Negotiate credit terms and scheme payouts with distributors before each season.
- Prepare the monthly sales forecast by product and distributor for the regional manager.

Sales Officer, Deccan Electricals Pvt Ltd, Pune (2018 - 2020)
- Covered 60 electrical retailers on a fixed beat and booked orders for the distributor.

SKILLS
Excel, DMS, SFA app

EDUCATION
MBA Marketing, Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune, 2018
